display.purpose: Page titles and record column names. Black, 900-weight, tight leading.

body.purpose: Form inputs and body text. Bold, 16px minimum.

label.purpose: All labels, buttons, navigation. Uppercase, 900-weight, 0.15em tracking.

shadows.name: toast-float
shadows.purpose: Undo toast only — the sole elevated surface in the system.

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: Drawer slide-in. Slow, deliberate, no bounce.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button. Solid black, white text, uppercase.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #000; color: #fff; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #000; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent with 2px black border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #000; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 2px solid #000; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #000; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #000; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Underline Input
components.description: Clean underline input. Transparent bg, 2px bottom border.
components.css: .ds-input-underline { width: 100%; padding: 8px 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: #000; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.2); border-radius: 0; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .ds-input-underline:focus { border-bottom-color: #000; } .ds-input-underline::placeholder { color: rgba(0,0,0,0.35); font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Ranking Card (Red)
components.description: Red list ranking card — high value items.
components.css: .ds-rank-red { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 16px; background: #c0392b; color: #fff; border: 2px solid #c0392b; border-radius: 0; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .ds-rank-red .ds-rank-num { width: 32px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 900; } .ds-rank-red .ds-rank-name { flex: 1; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-rank-red .ds-rank-score { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 900; }

narrative.overview: 「观演红黑榜」的视觉系统是一座地下档案室——每一场演出都是一份档案，每一种颜色都是一枚标签。它拒绝 SaaS 模板的圆角与渐变，拒绝 Material Design 的标准化组件，拒绝日系茶系的暖纸色。它是一面钉满海报的水泥墙：高饱和色块、粗体无衬线字、纯黑纯白直角边框。这个系统只有一个目的：让每一次观演记录都有视觉分量。
keyCharacteristics: 纯白表面 + 纯黑墨水 + 2px直角边框
四列高饱和 OKLCH 色块用于记录分类
底划线输入 + 透明背景

rules.name: The Black-and-White Rule
rules.body: 页面骨架只用纯黑与纯白。没有奶油白、暖纸色、冷灰——只有 #000 和 #fff。

rules.name: The Four-Color Rule
rules.body: 四列分类色是 ONLY 的彩色元素（除红榜和星星外）。

rules.name: The Extreme Contrast Rule
rules.body: 只用两个字重：font-black (900) 和 font-bold (700)。

rules.name: The 0.15em Rule
rules.body: 所有标签和按钮使用统一 letter-spacing: 0.15em。

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: 表面在静止时是平的。阴影只在需要传达临时浮起时出现。

dos: Do use 2px solid borders for all structural elements
Do use font-black (900) for every label, button, and heading
Do use 0.15em letter-spacing on all labels and buttons
Do keep body text at 1rem (16px) minimum
Do use the four OKLCH colors ONLY for record column backgrounds
Do keep surfaces flat — shadows only for toast and drawer
donts: Don't use border-left/right > 1px as colored stripes on cards
Don't use Inter, Roboto, or any web font — system fonts only
Don't use cream, sand, beige, or warm-tinted backgrounds
Don't use Material Design, daisyUI, or third-party UI libraries
Don't use purple-blue gradients, glassmorphism, or SaaS clichés
